headline: European Telecom Operator Iliad Posts 5% Revenue Growth in Q3
summary: Telecommunications provider Iliad Group generated 5% revenue growth during the third quarter, driven by continuous expansion across its broadband and mobile customer networks in France, Italy, and Poland.
why: Iliad is one of Europe's major low-cost telecommunications groups, competing directly with incumbent telecom operators across continental Europe.

impacts.name: European Telecommunications
impacts.why: Steady top-line growth highlights resilient subscriber demand in European mobile and fixed broadband.
